subject: Acumen Health — prepay + split invoice request and temporary credit cap
messages:
From: Ava Reynolds <payments@acumenhealth.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: matt.turner@acumenhealth.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice cadence and credit ceiling request — Acumen Health

Hi Ben,

Hope you’re well. We’re getting final approvals in place for the pilot purchase order (PO # AH-9873) but have a temporary cashflow constraint this quarter. Our AP team is asking whether Redwood would consider the following as a one-time onboarding accommodation: 

- Issue a first invoice for 50% of the pilot value immediately (we’ll pay within 10 business days once received).
- Issue a second invoice for the remaining 50% on Net60 from the invoice date (instead of standard Net30).
- Temporarily increase the credit cap for Acumen to $100,000 for the first 60 days while we complete internal sign-offs and intercompany transfers.

I’ve attached our AP statement and the signed PO for reference. We’re happy to provide any additional vendor onboarding paperwork.

Can you let me know if this is something Redwood can accommodate? If useful, I can get our finance exec (Matthew Turner) on a short call later this week.

Thanks,
Ava Reynolds
Accounts Payable — Acumen Health
attachments: Acumen_AP_statement_Q3.pdf, PO_AH-9873.pdf
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Ava Reynolds <payments@acumenhealth.com>
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice cadence and credit ceiling request — Acumen Health

Thanks for the note, Ava — and congrats on getting PO AH-9873 through the product team. Quick response from our side: we can consider a split-invoice approach for onboarding but will need to confirm a few controls before approving a temporary cap.

Key items we need to validate:
- VAT/tax residency proof for Acumen (to confirm whether we need to reissue with reverse-charge or different tax lines).
- A short credit check and AR review (standard for new enterprise customers requesting >$50k temporary cap).
- Clear milestone definition for the pilot (so we can tie staged billing to deliverables).

I’ve drafted a brief termsheet that outlines the conditional arrangement (50% upfront invoice, balance on extended net terms, temporary cap, credit review). See attached: Redwood_Termsheet_v2.docx.

I’m looping in Naomi from Finance and Lauren from Customer Success to assess from credit and delivery perspectives. Naomi — can you review the attached terms and advise on a provisional cap we can offer pending a one-week credit check? Lauren — can you confirm the pilot milestone that will be used to justify the second invoice timing?

If it helps, I’m available for a 20-min call Thursday afternoon.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_Termsheet_v2.docx
From: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice cadence and credit ceiling request — Acumen Health

Ben / Lauren — reviewed Ava’s request and the draft termsheet. Proposed finance-led conditional arrangement below: 

1) Interim structure we can extend to Acumen (pilot-only, one-time exception):
   - Invoice A: 50% of total due on receipt (expect payment within 10 business days). This will be treated as a prepayment and held against consumption.
   - Invoice B: Remaining 50% invoiced with Net45 (not Net60) but with a negotiated grace-window; if customer requests Net60 we can accept it subject to a formal credit uplift.

2) Provisional credit cap: $75,000 initial for 30 days while we complete a standard credit assessment. If the assessment results are satisfactory we can uplift to $90,000 for the following 30 days.

3) Conditions (must be provided before the second invoice is issued):
   - VAT registration certificate or equivalent documentation for Acumen (scan or PDF).
   - Signed PO (received).
   - Company registry extract or DUNS number (for the credit check).

4) Docs & execution: I’ll generate a short addendum to the termsheet and route via DocuSign for signatures — we’ll need both the AP contact and a named purchasing authority.

Notes:
- We prefer Net45 as the extended term in our invoices to limit exposure; Net60 can be escalated to finance leadership for approval (adds 24–48 hours).
- If Acumen insists on Net60 for Sunday’s second invoice, we should request an automatic ACH pre-authorization or card-on-file to mitigate collection risk.

Lauren — can you confirm the pilot milestone and expected delivery timeline so we can tie Invoice B to a clear event? Once Naomi starts the credit pull I’ll put a temporary hold on the cap uplift until results arrive.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Finance — Redwood Inference
From: Ava Reynolds <payments@acumenhealth.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: Matthew Turner <matt.turner@acumenhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice cadence and credit ceiling request — Acumen Health

Ben / Naomi,

Thanks for the quick review and the proposed approach — appreciate the flexibility. A few clarifications from our side:

- Acumen can sign the addendum & terms via DocuSign (please send).
- We can provide VAT registration and DUNS by EOB tomorrow.
- We strongly prefer Net60 for the second invoice because our internal treasury approval runs on a 45–60 day cycle; that said, the 50% upfront is workable and we can prioritize paying that immediately.

If you can provisionally set the temporary cap to $90,000 pending the credit check, that would avoid us needing to reissue payment instructions mid-cycle. Otherwise we’ll proceed with the 50% upfront and expect to re-negotiate the remainder during the credit-review window.

Attached: signed PO (PO_AH-9873.pdf) — again thanks for working with us on timing.

Best,
Ava
Accounts Payable — Acumen Health
attachments: PO_AH-9873.pdf

Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 15:42:00 -0700

Quick internal update and proposed next steps to take back to Acumen: 

- Offer: issue Invoice A for 50% immediately (prepay) and Invoice B for remaining 50% with Net60, but conditional. Finance will run a credit check within 48 hours; if results are acceptable we’ll confirm a provisional cap of $90,000 for 60 days. If not acceptable, revert to $75k cap and Net45 for Invoice B.

- Requirements we must receive before Invoice B is issued: VAT registration doc, DUNS or company registry extract, and signed DocuSign addendum accepting the staged billing schedule.

- Owners: Naomi to run credit assessment (owner: naomi_feldman). Lauren to confirm pilot milestone and expected delivery date for milestone tie (owner: lauren_bishop). Ben to coordinate communication and send DocuSign link to Acumen (owner: ben_carter).

Action items:
- Naomi: start credit check now; advise by Wed EOD with a recommended provisional cap.
- Lauren: confirm milestone by Tue EOD so I can lock the invoice triggering event.
- Ben: I’ll prepare the DocuSign addendum and the initial 50% invoice once I have confirmation of milestone.

Ava — I’ll send the DocuSign link shortly and follow up once Naomi confirms the provisional cap. Appreciate the pragmatism here — this feels like a clean path to get the pilot live without slowing down procurement.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
